Create quilts using over 200 quilt blocks to select from. You can change the colors in the blocks to get the look you want. Now you can create your own blocks to use in your quilts. Comes with 3 free quilt patterns. Download is free. To activate creation is $2.99 Once activated, get started by doing the following: To Create a Quilt 1. Select "Create a Quilt" button. 2. Enter the type of quilt (square or on point), and the quilt width and quilt height in blocks. 3. Select the Block Icon (forth icon in the tool bar) 4. A huge selection of quilt blocks will appear. 5. Select the quilt blocks you want to place on your quilt. 6. Select the Color Icon (first icon in the tool bar) 7. A huge selection of colors will appear 8. Select a color and select the Fill-All bucket icon with a double plus sign (11th icon in the tool bar) 9. Select on the quilt, all the blocks of the same kind will change color to the color you selected. Buttons from left to right in the button bar: Color button - use to select any color Save button - use to save your quilt pattern Sashing button - use it to add sashing around each quilt block (vertical, horizontal or both) Quilt blocks button - use it to select different quilt blocks to your quilt My Quilt Blocks button - displays all the blocks you have created Cut button - select a block on your quilt and the cut icon to remove it Copy button - select a block on your quilt and the copy icon to copy it and place it in another location on your quilt Rotate button - select a quilt block and rotate icon to rotate that block Resize quilt button - select to change the number of block rows and columns for your quilt Dropper button - select a color from your quilt to use Paint bucket button - use this when you want to change the color of one fabric in a single block Paint bucket + button - use this when you want to change the fabric color in a single block Paint bucket ++ button - use this when you want to change the fabric color in all blocks Undo button - undo last things you did Redo button - redo the things you undid Zoom in button - zoom in on your quilt pattern Zoom out button - zoom out on your quilt pattern Print button Share button - share a picture of your pattern using email, text etc. Help button - help on how to use features of the app To Create a Block 1. Select "Create a Block" button. 2. Select the size of the block you want to create (5-16 inches) 3. Now add shapes to your block. Shapes come in three sizes (3 sides, 4 sides and 5 sides) 4. Select the triangle to add a triangle shape to your block. 5. To change the shape just drag any of the green corner circles to where you want. 6. You can also flip, rotate and resize the shape using button in the button bar. 7. You can drag the shape to any location. Shapes snap into place. 8. Select the Color button (first button in the button bar to change the colors of your shapes) Buttons from left to right in the button bar: Color button - use to select a color for your fabric shapes in your block Save button - use to save your block Triangle shape button - add triangle fabric shapes to your block Square shape button - add 4 sided shapes to your block Pentagon shape button - add 5 sided shapes to your block Resize shape larger button - select a shape and the resize larger button to make the shape a size larger Resize shape smaller button - select a shape and the resize smaller button to make a shape a size smaller Flip shape horizontal button - select a shape and the Flip horizontal button to flip the shape horizontally Flip shape vertical button - select a shape and the Flip horizontal button to flip the shape vertically Rotate shape button - select a shape and the Rotate button to rotate a shape Dropper button - select a color from your block to use Paint bucket button - use this when you want to change the color of fabrics in your block Cut button - use to remove a shape from your block Copy button - use to copy Print button

QuiltPop helps you create one of a kind projects using the technique of foundation paper piecing, and allows you to print each block from your home printer. Foundation paper block designs are ready for you to create your own layouts, or premade projects that you can scroll through and make. QuiltPop allows you to change the size of each block, rotate them, flip them, color them, and then print them - all with numbered instructions in which order you should sew your fabric to the paper. Foundation paper piecing helps to create crisp and accurate lines when sewing, no matter how small you make the block size. You can print individual blocks or the entire block set of your quilt design. Perfect projects for this technique include: - Quilt tops - Wall hangings - Table runners - Pillows - Mug rugs - Coasters - Pin cushions - Center pieces for bags Use up your fabric stash and learn a new sewing technique to add to your skill set. Whether you're a beginner or expert quilter, QuiltPop can be easily used by everyone.

Robert Kaufman Fabrics and Quilter's Paradise have joined forces to bring you a collection of eight essential quilting calculators. With these calculators you'll be able to quickly convert between yards and inches, meters and centimeters; learn how much fabric you need for backing, batting and borders; and determine how many rectangular pieces can be cut from a larger piece. There are even calculators for square-in-a-square, set-in and corner triangles. Here's a brief description of each calculator: Fabric Measurement Converter: Converts between inches and yards in decimal form, and yards in fractional form. (With metric equivalents.) Backing and Batting Calculator: Determines how much material from a bolt of fabric is needed to make the backing for a quilt. Piece Count Calculator: Shows the number of fixed-sized pieces of fabric that can be cut from a larger piece. Pieces to Area Calculator: Indicates how much fabric is needed in order to cut a given number of fixed-sized pieces. Binding Calculator: Tells you the amount of fabric required to bind your quilt, based on the quilt’s dimensions and the binding strip width. Border Calculator: Shows the amount of fabric required to create borders, based on a quilt’s dimensions and the width of the borders. Square-in-a-Square Calculator: Works out the key dimensions of a square-in-a-square block. Set-in and Corner Triangle Calculator: Determines the size of the square piece you’ll need to cut in order to create both unfinished set-in triangles and unfinished corner triangles.

Features: • Choose from common quilt size presets • Generate quilt layouts using multiple pattern styles • Estimate fabric yardage based on finished block size and fabric width • View block counts and actual quilt dimensions after full-block rounding • See cut size vs finished size with standard 1/4" seam allowance guidance • Review per-fabric yardage breakdowns for your layout Quilt Organizer is designed as a simple planning tool for quilters who want a clearer starting point before cutting fabric.

Use the Paint tool to play with color and create your design on your device. Three papers are included with purchase: Standard grid, Diagonal for on-point quilts, and Dots for free-form quilt planning. InApp purchases add 24 hard-to-find specialty papers. Buy any five papers (or purchase the ’All Papers Forever’ BUNDLE) to unlock all papers forever. Credit is given for every purchase so that on purchase of any fifth paper the bundle is instantly added: Hexagon Lone Star - 8 point star Triangle Diamond Log Cabin HST & HRT template 6 point star Tumbler Polygon (especially helpful to make shapes for EPP) Honeycomb (Lucy Boston) Jewel Kite Brick Square Circle Arc Pinwheel Jewel Ring Concentric Hexagon Pineapple Apple Core Coffin Pentagon House Tools for better EPP Templates! Once a template is ready, print and cut by hand or save as a PDF or SVG and export to a cutting machine. Includes a Paint Tool! The Paint Tool colors with solids and textures. Special feature adds an inspiration image under a grid before bringing a graph paper into Paint. There is a set of built-in color palettes, however, you can add colors to create unlimited custom pallets from images, live camera, color wheel, RGB or HSB codes. Unique HST & HRT paper This InApp purchase creates templates at any size — Half Square Triangle Template at any size, set seam allowance. Half Rectangle Triangle Template at any size, set seam allowance. Paper template includes markings to aid trimming corners for accurate matching during assembly (no ‘dog ears’). PURCHASE INCLUDES 3 PAPERS: Grid Classic grid graph paper taken up a notch! Dot Choice of 5 dot styles and 2 dot patterns for free-form quilt planning. Diagonal On-point design graph paper. — FEATURES OF ALL PAPERS — √ Buy once — purchase works on all devices — iPhone, iPad, iPod. √ Metric (cm or mm) and Inch settings for grid and page size. √ Paint quilt layout with color and pattern. Add unlimited custom color palettes. √ Place an inspiration image under any grid. √ Up to four line colors on a grid. √ Tile multiple grids on a page for planning block designs, assembly, etc. √ Title grid with choice of font, size, bold or italic, and color. √ Print on standard sized page (such as 8.5x11 or A4) portrait or landscape, or set to a custom size. √ Avoid the headache of scaling a design by setting the page to the quilt actual size by using setting for ‘Custom’ page size. √ Library of Quick Pick templates offer inspiration and a short cut to creating layouts. √ Print, share, or upload grids as a PDF, PNG or SVG √ Share painted grids as a PNG or PDF √ Work up close using pinch-n-zoom gesture. QuiltFit is a focused quilt planning workspace for quilters who want to move from idea to fabric without a spreadsheet. Start with a block pattern, choose fabrics, preview the full quilt, estimate yardage, build a shopping list, create a cutting plan and follow the sewing sequence from one app. It is made for patchwork beginners, weekend makers, guild quilters, sewing teachers and anyone who wants a clearer path from "I love this pattern" to "I know what to buy, cut and sew." QuiltFit keeps the workflow practical: design first, then fabric requirements, then cutting, then piecing. Design your quilt visually Choose a classic block pattern such as Nine Patch, Log Cabin, Half-Square Triangle or Flying Geese. Set the quilt width and height in blocks, pick a finished block size and see the finished size update as you work. The preview shows how the block repeats across the whole project, so color balance and contrast are easier to judge before you cut real fabric. Add fabrics you own or plan to buy. Use built-in colors and textures, create custom fabrics, name them, and assign them to the block. Paint a single cell, fill a role, or use Magic Fill to quickly explore layouts and compare palettes before cutting. Fabric planning and shopping list Once fabrics are assigned, QuiltFit calculates yardage estimates for each fabric based on project size, block size, seam allowance and safety margin. The shopping list turns those estimates into a checklist with fabric names, colors, quantities and optional prices. Mark items as bought, share the list, or bring it to the fabric shop. Cutting made less confusing QuiltFit turns the design into a cut list with piece counts and cut sizes. Use the simple list for a fast checklist, or the visual cutting view to see work grouped by fabric. Export a printable PDF cut list with fabric requirements and piece sizes — a clean plan you can check, print and follow. Sewing guidance block by block After shopping and cutting, QuiltFit helps you move into sewing. Illustrated steps break the selected block into smaller actions: cut pieces, arrange units, sew seams, press, assemble rows and complete blocks. Track progress across the blocks in your quilt top so the project feels manageable instead of scattered across notes, photos and memory. Project library and settings Save multiple quilts in the project library, switch between them and keep each design's fabrics, size, progress and settings together. Adjust seam allowance, safety margin, block size, project status and language from the settings screen. QuiltFit is designed as a compact planning notebook for the quilting work that happens before and during sewing. Privacy built into the workflow QuiltFit is built around five practical promises: Offline: core planning tools are available without relying on a web account. No Login: open the app and design, calculate, cut and sew without creating an account. Privacy First: quilt names, fabric choices, notes and project details stay personal. On Device: planning, yardage, cut lists, PDFs, settings and progress are handled on your device. No Cloud Upload: QuiltFit does not upload your projects, fabric lists, shopping lists, cut plans or sewing progress to its own cloud. Subscription QuiltFit Pro unlocks Magic Fill, cutting layouts and PDF export. It is a monthly or yearly auto-renewing subscription with a 3-day free trial. Payment is charged to your Apple ID after the trial and at renewal, unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the period ends. Manage or cancel in App Store account settings. Support https://5gotogo.github.io/QuiltFit-privacy/apple-review-support.html Privacy Policy https://5gotogo.github.io/QuiltFit-privacy/privacy-policy.html
